cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll arrange coffee for Sunday. That year apart did us good; we're ready to manage this properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We needed the break to stop making free afternoons prove anything. You choose the cafe; I'll come to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Monday, then, or whichever day is free. I'll keep the arrangement simple. Look at what that year taught us: I can organize a coffee without organizing the rest of your weekend.
